method.extended: Latest positive 1-minute bar close within provider pre/post windows; zero/missing volume does not establish a new trade and must be disclosed
method.returns: pre vs preceding regular close; post vs same-day regular close; do not add percentages
method.alerts: Extended prices do not update the regular-close four-symbol alert state
method.scope: No overnight 20:00-04:00 quotes; pre/post data are venue/provider snapshots, not guaranteed consolidated executable quotes
